documents.doc-cz-os-pha4-2026-09-16-10-c-69-2026-p: On 16 September 2026, in case 10 C 69/2026 (Mgr. Dušan Dvořák v Czech Television, protection of personality), the Prague 4 District Court summoned the claimant to the first hearing, scheduled for 24 November 2026 at 13:00 in courtroom 3.308. The document fixes a concrete hearing date; it does not decide the merits of the case. The previous elapsed-time timer for waiting on the next procedural step is therefore removed, while the court case itself remains active.
